newsitem.title: USA: American ECO stake acquired by group.
newsitem.headline: American ECO stake acquired by group.

text.p: An investor group that includes two investment partnerships on Wednesday said it acquired the equivalent of 1,141,883 shares of American ECO Corp., or 9.24 percent of the total outstanding.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought convertible debentures and warrants from the company that give it the right to purchase its stake. It said it made the purchases for investment purposes.
The group includes ProFutures Bridge Capital Fund L.P. in Englewood, Colo., and ProFutures Special Equities Fund L.P. in Austin, Texas.
